quiz.title: Vocabulaire de base : phrases courantes pour parler de l'extérieur
quiz.subject: Anglais

answers.correction: 'It's sunny', 'It's raining', and 'It's windy' are all common English expressions used to describe the weather outside.
The English expression for 'Il fait beau' is indeed 'It's sunny', which is a common way to describe nice weather in English.
'It's raining' is a common English expression used to describe the weather outside when it's raining.
The English expression for 'Il pleut' is indeed 'It's raining', which is a common way to describe rainy weather in English.
'It's windy' is a common English expression used to describe the weather outside when it's windy.
The English expression for 'Il fait du vent' is indeed 'It's windy', which is a common way to describe windy weather in English.
'It's cold' is a common English expression used to describe the weather outside when it's cold.
The English expression for 'Il fait froid' is indeed 'It's cold', which is a common way to describe cold weather in English.
